description: A California twirl from the mirror start: the robin and lark trade places under a raised hand.

walkthrough.line: Take one hand with {who}, the robin's right in the lark's left. The lark raises it, the robin walks under, and you trade places.
walkthrough.teach: Stand with the robin on the left and the lark on the right — the mirror of an ordinary California twirl, which starts with the lark on the left — and take one hand with {who}: the robin's right in the lark's left. The lark raises the joined hand and walks forward round the outside; the robin walks under it and round. The two of you trade places and end facing the way you came from.
